summary: Shared key-value AI memory, so perception, combat and movement need no references to each other.
overview: A plain data store for facts an AI's systems all need — last known player position, is alerted, current target. Deliberately not tied to any AI architecture: a squad, a single enemy or a dialogue system can all use it, which is why the dialogue runner gates conditional choices on one.
useCases: Perception writing a last-known position that movement reads.
Gating a dialogue choice on a quest flag.
Squad memory shared between several agents.

gotchas.title: Keys are strings, checked by nobody
gotchas.body: A typo writes a new key rather than failing. Constants are worth the small effort here.

gotchas.title: It has no notion of staleness
gotchas.body: A last-known position stays until something overwrites it. Expiry is the perception layer's job, not the store's.
